        'web|--host' = 'The address to bind, an IP or localhost; [web] host when omitted.'
        'web|--port' = 'The port, 0 for any free one; [web] port when omitted.'
        'web|--no-token' = 'Serve /ws without the token; refused unless the host is loopback.'
        'web|--config' = 'The config file to load instead of the user''s.'
        'web|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'web|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'web|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'wrap|--config' = 'The config file to use instead of ~/.rtok/config.toml.'
        'wrap|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'wrap|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'wrap|--version' = 'Show version.'
    }
    $cmd = ''
    $skip = $false
    foreach ($element in ($commandAst.CommandElements | Select-Object -Skip 1)) {
        if ($element.Extent.EndOffset -ge $cursorPosition) { break }
        $word = $element.ToString()
        if ($skip) {
            $skip = $false
        } elseif ($word.StartsWith('-')) {
            $skip = $values -contains "$cmd|$word"
        } elseif ($children[$cmd] -contains $word) {
            $cmd = "$cmd $word".Trim()
        }
    }
    if ($skip) { return }
    $list = if ($wordToComplete.StartsWith('-')) { $options[$cmd] } else { $children[$cmd] }
    foreach ($item in $list) {
        if ($item.StartsWith($wordToComplete, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)) {
            $hint = $hints["$cmd|$item"]
            if (-not $hint) { $hint = $item }
            [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($item, $item, 'ParameterValue', $hint)
        }
    }
}
